description: Source code implementing proxy configuration logic for network proxy resolution, including classes and functions for managing proxy rules, parsing proxy strings, and converting configurations to a value representation.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Represents network proxy configuration, including automatic and manual proxy rules, PAC URL, and system settings.

classes.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules
classes.description: Encapsulates rules for proxy selection, including proxy lists per scheme, fallback proxies, and bypass rules.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the proxy configuration into a base::Value dictionary for inspection or storage.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::Apply
methods.description: Applies the proxy rules to a given URL, determining the appropriate proxy or direct connection.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::ParseFromString
methods.description: Parses a string defining proxy rules into structured proxy lists.
